question_pt: Quais são os 10 municípios do RS com mais internações por diabetes mellitus?
next_action: Comparar colunas/linhas esperadas e revisar selecao/agregacao.
generated_sql:
WITH agg AS (
    SELECT
        m.NO_MUNICIPIO AS municipio,
        m.SG_UF AS uf,
        COUNT(*) AS internacoes
    FROM internacoes i
    LEFT JOIN municipios m
        ON i.MUNIC_RES = m.CO_MUNICIPIO_6D
    WHERE m.SG_UF = 'RS'
      AND (
        i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'E10%'
        OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'E11%'
        OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'E12%'
        OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'E13%'
        OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'E14%'
      )
    GROUP BY m.NO_MUNICIPIO, m.SG_UF
)
SELECT
    municipio,
    uf,
    internacoes
FROM agg
ORDER BY internacoes DESC, municipio ASC
LIMIT 10

question_pt: Compare por ano, de 2019 a 2023, as internações por câncer de mama e câncer de próstata.
next_action: Comparar colunas/linhas esperadas e revisar selecao/agregacao.
generated_sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.DT_INTER) AS ano,
        CASE
            WHEN i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'C50%' THEN 'Cancer de mama'
            WHEN i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'C61%' THEN 'Cancer de prostata'
        END AS diagnostico,
        COUNT(*) AS internacoes
    FROM internacoes i
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.DT_INTER) BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023
      AND (
            i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'C50%'
         OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'C61%'
      )
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    ano,
    diagnostico,
    internacoes
FROM base
ORDER BY ano ASC, diagnostico ASC;
ground_truth_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.DT_INTER) AS ano, SUM(CASE WHEN i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'C50%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS internacoes_cancer_mama, SUM(CASE WHEN i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'C61%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS internacoes_cancer_prostata FROM internacoes i WHERE i.DT_INTER IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.DT_INTER) BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 AND (i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'C50%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'C61%') GROUP BY ano ORDER BY ano

question_pt: Quais são os 10 diagnósticos principais mais frequentes dentro de apendicite?
next_action: Comparar colunas/linhas esperadas e revisar selecao/agregacao.
generated_sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        c.DESCRICAO,
        COUNT(*) AS total
    FROM internacoes i
    JOIN cid c
      ON i.DIAG_PRINC = c.CID
    WHERE (i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'K35%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'K36%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'K37%')
    GROUP BY c.DESCRICAO
)
SELECT
    DESCRICAO,
    total
FROM base
ORDER BY total DESC, DESCRICAO ASC
LIMIT 10
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.CID AS cid, c.DESCRICAO AS diagnostico, COUNT(*) AS internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i.DIAG_PRINC = c.CID WHERE i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'K35%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'K36%' OR i.DIAG_PRINC LIKE 'K37%' GROUP BY c.CID, c.DESCRICAO ORDER BY internacoes DESC, cid ASC LIMIT 10
